question: Do the pinned author example and GEO deposits establish exact source-cell membership and the biological design needed for the next Wagner reproduction stage?
decision: Qualify only a descriptive precomputed-score reproduction when exact identities match; hold population inference and full Compass until their separate requirements are met.
strongest_rival: Matching sample totals conceal different cells, condition labels or processing; library and batch labels may be mistaken for independent animals.
discriminator: Exact author SRX-to-GEO joins, unique SRR-labelled matrix columns, matching conditions, Git-blob/hash checks and an explicit within-series design inventory.
exposure_record: Published figures, author tutorial outputs, prior session literature, GEO series counts and selected identity fields were inspected before freezing. Downloaded expression and penalty values are not inspected by this metadata entrypoint.
biological_unit: Animal or independent source preparation; unresolved for sorted cells, explicit animal labels to be inventoried within each bulk or ATAC series.
nesting_and_overlap: Cells are nested in unresolved cultures/animals. Runs may repeat one animal. Repeated WT labels across series do not prove cross-assay pairing. Author SRR-to-SRX mapping is accepted as declared and not independently verified with SRA RunInfo.
population_and_selection: All sample entities of five declared GEO child series; all cells and matrix columns in the pinned non-micropooled Th17 author example. No outcome-based selection.
contrast: Identity concordance between source files and availability of within-series design labels; no expression comparison.
endpoint: Exact cell-to-GSM join, series sample inventory, explicit animal/treatment/genotype/run labels, source provenance and per-stage eligibility.
methods: Read SOFT metadata through the existing validated family reader and an allowlisted SRA/source-label parser. Require unique exact membership and condition matches. Inspect matrix headers only. Verify SHA-256 acquisition manifests and Git blob identities against the pinned tree. Preserve unknown biological units.
missingness_and_exclusions: No sample exclusions. Missing animal or preparation labels remain blank. Duplicate, missing, conflicting or mismatched identities and hash failures stop execution.
multiplicity: No hypothesis tests; counts are source inventory endpoints.
precision_basis: Metadata qualification supplies no power, effect margin or biological precision claim.
interpretation_limit: Library identity and source-file concordance do not establish independent replication, measured flux, pathogenicity, historical runtime equivalence, or linked early/later biological endpoints.
stop_rule: Stop on any provenance or exact-join failure. After extraction, keep unresolved biological inference, full solver reproduction and assay-specific numerical stages held. No expression scoring in this run.
amendment_reason: Initial outcome-exposed source qualification; starts the structured pipeline without changing historical evidence.
